description:
The classic game of X and O, redrawn for your iPhone. Every mark is sketched on with a smooth animated stroke, every win gets a glowing strike-through, and every round takes seconds.

Play solo against three computer opponents. Easy makes mistakes, Medium blocks and counters, and Impossible uses perfect play. It cannot lose. The best you can do is force a draw, and even that takes focus.

Or switch to 2 Players and pass the phone back and forth. The opening move alternates each round so nobody gets an unfair edge, and the scoreboard remembers your tally between sessions.
whatsNew: New hand-drawn stroke animations, confetti when you win, keyboard support, and a smarter Medium opponent.
